<observations>
Date: Mar 20, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User will enforce strict null checks in the Ledgerly TypeScript config.
* 🟢 (08:20) User prefers coffee from the downtown café during coding sessions.
* 🔴 (09:40) User stated the SOC 2 audit fieldwork starts on May 19, 2026.
* 🔴 (10:30) User decided to switch the database from SQLite to PostgreSQL for production.
* 🟡 (13:20) Agent configured CI pipeline to cache node_modules for faster builds.
* 🟡 (14:05) ✅ Agent configured Jest to enforce 85% test coverage.
* 🟡 (15:10) Agent linted source files, fixing 7 auto-fixable warnings, and generated API documentation for `/invoices`.
* 🔴 (20:30) User asked for a summary of pending pull requests and their reviewers.

Date: Mar 23, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User will adopt semantic commit messages for all future commits.
* 🟡 (08:45) Agent ran integration tests for the payment webhook (5 passed, 1 flaky).
* 🟡 (09:20) ✅ Agent merged PR #42 (add discount code validation) after review from @sara.
* 🟡 (10:30) Agent updated Dockerfile to use `node:18-alpine` and added a GitHub Actions step to upload test artifacts to S3.
* 🟢 (11:50) User asked if the new discount feature could be toggled via feature flag.
* 🟡 (12:25) Agent implemented a feature flag for the discount feature using the LaunchDarkly SDK.
* 🟡 (13:00) ✅ Agent updated README with LaunchDarkly setup instructions.
* 🔴 (13:00) User stated the public API rate limit is 300 requests per minute.
* 🟡 (13:45) Agent refactored invoice PDF generation to use the `pdf-lib` library.
* 🟢 (14:30) User will attend a virtual meetup on TypeScript best practices at 16:00.
* 🟡 (15:15) Agent scheduled a meeting with the UX designer to discuss invoice layout redesign.

Date: Mar 26, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User will start using TypeScript strict mode across the repository.
* 🟡 (07:48) Agent created a new branch `feature/recurring-invoices` and ran unit tests for the tax calculation module (all 32 passed).
* 🟡 (09:50) Agent opened PR #58 to add locale-aware date formatting.
* 🟡 (11:10) Agent updated CI workflow to cache `node_modules` for faster builds.
* ✅ (12:00) Agent merged PR #58 (locale-aware date formatting) after approval from @mike.
* 🟡 (12:45) Agent added `EMAIL_SMTP_URL` to `.env.example` and implemented email notifications for overdue invoices using `nodemailer`.
* 🟡 (15:00) Agent refactored logging to use the `pino` library with JSON output.
* 🔴 (16:40) User asked whether the recurring invoice feature could be paused per client.
* 🟡 (18:05) Agent added a ConfigCat feature toggle "recurringPause" for client-level control of recurring invoices.
* 🟡 (19:45) Agent scheduled a demo session with the sales team to showcase recurring invoices.

Date: Mar 29, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to adopt dark mode UI across the Ledgerly dashboard.
* 🟡 (07:45) Agent created `feature/dark-mode` branch, added CSS variables for themes, and implemented a React toggle component.
* 🔴 (10:20) User stated the public API rate limit was raised to 500 requests per minute.
* 🟡 (10:40) Agent ran unit tests for the theme toggle (all 20 passed).
* 🟡 (12:05) Agent merged `feature/dark-mode` into `develop` after code review from @sara.
* 🟡 (12:45) Agent updated the CI pipeline to run visual regression tests with Percy.
* ✅ (13:30) Agent deployed the dark mode feature to the staging environment for QA.
* 🔴 (14:15) User asked if bulk invoice upload could support Excel (.xlsx) files.
* 🟡 (15:00) Agent added a new endpoint `/api/v1/invoices/bulk-upload` handling `.xlsx` via SheetJS.
* 🟡 (16:20) Agent ran integration tests for bulk upload (12 passed, 2 skipped).

Date: Apr 2, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) User decided to add recurring invoice templates to Ledgerly.
* 🟡 (07:55) Agent created `recurring_invoices` database table and implemented API endpoint `/api/v1/invoices/recurring` to manage templates.
* 🟡 (10:10) Agent wrote and ran 15 unit tests for the recurring endpoint (all passed).
* 🔴 (11:40) User asked whether PDF invoices could include a company logo watermark.
* 🟡 (12:30) Agent integrated `pdfmake` to generate PDFs with dynamic watermark support.
* ✅ (13:15) Agent deployed the PDF watermark feature to the staging environment for QA review.
* 🟢 (14:00) Teammate Luis reported staging server CPU spike after new jobs ran.
* 🟡 (15:05) Agent added a background job using BullMQ to process PDF generation asynchronously.
* 🟡 (16:20) Agent updated CI to include a load-test step simulating 200 concurrent PDF requests.
* ✅ (17:45) Agent merged `feature/recurring-invoices` into `develop` after approval from @kim.

Date: Apr 6, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User decided to integrate Stripe for handling subscription payments in Ledgerly.
* 🟡 (07:50) Agent created `stripeService.ts` with `createCustomer` and `handleWebhook` methods, and set up webhook endpoint `/api/v1/payments/stripe/webhook`.
* 🟡 (10:05) Agent wrote and ran 12 integration tests for the Stripe webhook (all passed).
* 🔴 (11:35) User asked whether payment receipt emails could include a QR code linking to the invoice.
* 🟡 (12:10) Agent integrated `qrcode` library to generate QR codes and attached them to email templates.
* ✅ (13:00) Agent deployed the Stripe integration and QR code email feature to the development environment for internal review.
* 🟢 (14:15) Teammate Maya reported local dev database size grew to 3.2 GB.
* 🟡 (15:40) Agent added a nightly cron database cleanup script to prune orphaned payment records.
* 🟡 (16:30) Assistant recommended Redis Streams for the background job queue; user agreed to try it.
* 🟡 (16:55) Agent updated CI pipeline to include a security scan using Snyk for new dependencies.
* ✅ (18:20) Agent merged `feature/stripe-integration` into `main` after approval from @alex.
</observations>
<current-task>
- Primary: Address the user's request for a summary of pending pull requests and their reviewers (from Mar 20).
- Secondary: Investigate the local dev database size growth (from Apr 6).
- Secondary: Implement Redis Streams for the background job queue (from Apr 6).
</current-task>
<suggested-response>
I can provide a summary of pending pull requests and their reviewers. Would you like me to start with that?
</suggested-response>
